[Story]
Zhang Wei moves to a new community recently, noticing that his neighbor Li Na's windows are always closed.

[Question]
Zhang Wei should be curious about the situation at Li Na's house, but he feels scared, why?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Zhang Wei finds out that the closed windows at Li Na's house are because Li Na keeps a large dog at home, this dog stays at home all the time.
B. Zhang Wei hears that Li Na once threatens her former neighbors, he worries that he also receives threats.
C. Zhang Wei thinks that Li Na's closed windows are because of the severe air pollution recently, he worries that his house also gets polluted.
D. Zhang Wei learns that there are a series of burglaries in the community recently, Li Na worries that her house also experiences the same thing.
